Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the installation and maintenance of signs indicating the end of school speed zones.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school speed zone signs; and adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If a school speed zone is created under RCW 46.61.440, theproper authority listed in subsection (2) of this section must installand maintain a sign indicating the end of the school speed zone. The sign must be installed on a state highway, county road, or city streetif the beginning of the school speed zone is also marked. Such signsmust be installed by January 1, 2015. (2)(a) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) ofthis section on a state highway, the department of transportation mustprovide for the installation and continued maintenance of the sign. (b) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) of thissection on a county road, the county must provide for the installationand continued maintenance of the sign. (c) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) of this p. 1 SHB 1698section on a city street, the city or town that has jurisdiction overthe city street must provide for the installation and continuedmaintenance of the sign. (3) A sign mandated under subsection (1) of this section mustconform to the "END SCHOOL ZONE" sign illustrated as sign S52 infigure 7B1 of the "Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices." Suchsigns must comply with the "Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices,"as adopted by the department, including rules regarding the minimumsize of such a sign and the minimum mounting height. A sign requiredby this section may be installed on a sign assembly that is alreadyplaced at the boundary of a school speed zone.
